name: 费奥多尔·陀思妥耶夫斯基

points.title: 童年与家庭
points.description: 陀思妥耶夫斯基出生于莫斯科的一个医生家庭，父亲是圣玛丽医院的医生，母亲来自一个商人家庭。童年时期，陀思妥耶夫斯基接受了严格的宗教教育，同时也接触了俄罗斯文学经典。1837年，母亲因肺结核去世，这对年幼的陀思妥耶夫斯基造成了深刻影响。同年，他被送往圣彼得堡的军事工程学院学习，开始了与父亲分离的生活。这段童年经历奠定了他作品中常见的家庭关系主题和对宗教的复杂态度。
points.descriptionEn: Dostoevsky was born in Moscow to a family of doctors. His father worked at the Mariinsky Hospital for the Poor, while his mother came from a merchant family. During his childhood, Dostoevsky received strict religious education while also being exposed to Russian literary classics. In 1837, his mother died of tuberculosis, which deeply affected the young Dostoevsky. Later that year, he was sent to the Military Engineering Academy in St. Petersburg, beginning his life separated from his father. This childhood experience laid the foundation for the common themes of family relationships and complex attitudes toward religion found in his works.

points.title: 文学起步与被捕
points.description: 1846年，陀思妥耶夫斯基发表了第一部作品《穷人》，获得了别林斯基的高度评价，一举成名。然而，他很快转向了更为激进的思想，加入了彼得拉舍夫斯基小组，这是一个讨论社会主义和空想社会主义的团体。1849年，因涉嫌参与反对沙皇的革命活动，陀思妥耶夫斯基被捕并被判处死刑。在行刑前最后一刻，死刑被减为西伯利亚苦役。这一生死经历成为他人生的重要转折点，深刻影响了他的世界观和文学创作，使他更加关注人类灵魂的深度和救赎的可能性。
points.descriptionEn: In 1846, Dostoevsky published his first work, 'Poor Folk,' which received high praise from Belinsky and brought him immediate fame. However, he soon turned to more radical ideas and joined the Petrashevsky Circle, a group that discussed socialism and utopian socialism. In 1849, he was arrested for suspected involvement in revolutionary activities against the Tsar and sentenced to death. At the last moment before execution, his sentence was commuted to hard labor in Siberia. This life-and-death experience became a major turning point in his life, profoundly influencing his worldview and literary work, leading him to focus more deeply on the human soul and the possibility of redemption.

points.title: 西伯利亚苦役
points.description: 陀思妥耶夫斯基在西伯利亚的鄂木斯克监狱度过了四年苦役生活，随后又被迫留在西伯利亚服役。这段经历让他接触到了社会底层人民，了解了他们的苦难与坚韧。在狱中，他与各种罪犯和政治犯共处，这为他后来作品中复杂的人物形象提供了素材。同时，他的宗教信仰在这一时期得到强化，开始更加关注东正教教义中的苦难与救赎主题。1857年，他与玛丽亚·伊萨耶娃结婚，这段婚姻并不幸福，但对他后来的创作产生了影响。1859年，陀思妥耶夫斯基终于获准返回俄罗斯欧洲部分。
points.descriptionEn: Dostoevsky spent four years in hard labor at the Omsk prison in Siberia, followed by compulsory service in the region. This experience allowed him to contact the lower classes of society and understand their suffering and resilience. In prison, he lived among various criminals and political prisoners, providing material for the complex characters in his later works. Meanwhile, his religious faith was strengthened during this period, and he began to focus more on the themes of suffering and redemption in Orthodox Christian teachings. In 1857, he married Maria Dmitrievna Isaeva, an unhappy marriage that nevertheless influenced his later work. In 1859, Dostoevsky was finally permitted to return to the European part of Russia.

points.title: 创作巅峰
points.description: 返回圣彼得堡后，陀思妥耶夫斯基进入了创作最丰产的时期。1866年，他创作了《罪与罚》，这部作品探讨了贫困、道德和救赎等主题，确立了他在文学史上的重要地位。1867年，他与安娜·格里戈里耶夫娜结婚，这段婚姻成为他生活的稳定支持。1868年，他完成了《白痴》，塑造了梅什金公爵这一理想主义人物形象。1872年，他发表了《群魔》，批判了激进政治思想。1879-1880年，他创作了《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》，这部被许多人视为他最伟大的作品，探讨了信仰、怀疑和道德责任等深刻主题。在这一时期，陀思妥耶夫斯基还积极参与公共辩论，发表了大量政论文章，表达了他对俄罗斯未来的思考。
points.descriptionEn: After returning to St. Petersburg, Dostoevsky entered his most productive creative period. In 1866, he wrote 'Crime and Punishment,' which explored themes of poverty, morality, and redemption, establishing his important place in literary history. In 1867, he married Anna Grigoryevna, whose support became a stabilizing force in his life. In 1868, he completed 'The Idiot,' creating the character of Prince Myshkin as an idealistic figure. In 1872, he published 'Demons,' critiquing radical political ideas. Between 1879-1880, he wrote 'The Brothers Karamazov,' considered by many his greatest work, exploring profound themes of faith, doubt, and moral responsibility. During this period, Dostoevsky also actively participated in public debates, publishing numerous political articles expressing his thoughts on Russia's future.

points.title: 晚年与逝世
points.description: 1880年，陀思妥耶夫斯基在普希金纪念碑揭幕仪式上发表演讲，表达了他对俄罗斯文学和民族精神的深刻理解，引起巨大反响。然而，他的健康状况已经严重恶化，长期受癫痫病折磨。1881年1月26日，陀思妥耶夫斯基在写作《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》期间因肺动脉栓塞去世，享年59岁。他的葬礼吸引了大批民众参加，被安葬在圣彼得堡的亚历山大-涅夫斯基修道院。陀思妥耶夫斯基的去世标志着俄罗斯文学黄金时代的结束，但他的思想和作品对后世产生了深远影响，被公认为世界文学史上最重要的作家之一。
points.descriptionEn: In 1880, Dostoevsky delivered a speech at the unveiling of the Pushkin monument, expressing his profound understanding of Russian literature and national spirit, which caused a huge sensation. However, his health had seriously deteriorated, and he had long suffered from epilepsy. On January 26, 1881, while working on 'The Brothers Karamazov,' Dostoevsky died of pulmonary embolism at the age of 59. His funeral attracted a large crowd of mourners, and he was buried in the Alexander Nevsky Lavra in St. Petersburg. Dostoevsky's death marked the end of the golden age of Russian literature, but his thoughts and works had a profound influence on later generations, and he is widely recognized as one of the most important writers in the history of world literature.

supporter.zh: 陀思妥耶夫斯基被支持者视为人类灵魂的伟大探索者，他的作品深入挖掘了人类内心的复杂性，揭示了信仰、道德和救赎的永恒主题。他通过笔下人物的挣扎与痛苦，展现了人类精神世界的深度和广度。陀思妥耶夫斯基对贫困、边缘人群的关注，以及他对人类尊严的捍卫，使他成为人道主义文学的典范。他的文学技巧和心理描写的深度，影响了后世无数作家，被誉为现代心理小说的奠基人之一。
supporter.en: Supporters view Dostoevsky as a great explorer of the human soul. His works deeply explore the complexity of the human inner world, revealing eternal themes of faith, morality, and redemption. Through the struggles and sufferings of his characters, he demonstrates the depth and breadth of the human spirit. Dostoevsky's concern for the poor and marginalized, along with his defense of human dignity, make him a model of humanitarian literature. His literary techniques and depth of psychological description have influenced countless writers and earned him recognition as one of the founders of the modern psychological novel.

critic.zh: 批评者指出陀思妥耶夫斯基作品中存在明显的矛盾和局限性。一方面，他批判激进思想，另一方面又表现出对专制制度的矛盾态度。他的宗教观点有时显得极端和教条化，对理性主义的批判有时过于简单化。一些评论家认为他的女性角色塑造存在刻板印象，过于理想化或妖魔化。此外，陀思妥耶夫斯基对西方文化的复杂态度也受到批评，他既吸收西方思想又强烈抵制，这种矛盾反映在他的作品中，有时导致思想上的不一致。
critic.en: Critics point out evident contradictions and limitations in Dostoevsky's work. On one hand, he criticized radical ideas, while on the other hand showing a contradictory attitude toward the autocratic system. His religious views sometimes appear extreme and dogmatic, and his critique of rationalism can be overly simplistic. Some critics argue that his portrayal of female characters contains stereotypes, being either overly idealized or demonized. Additionally, Dostoevsky's complex attitude toward Western culture has been criticized; he both absorbed and strongly resisted Western ideas, a contradiction reflected in his works and sometimes leading to ideological inconsistencies.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，陀思妥耶夫斯基被公认为19世纪俄罗斯文学的巨匠，与托尔斯泰齐名。他的作品超越了时代界限，成为探讨人类存在本质的经典。在心理学领域，他的小说被视为早期心理分析的实践，影响了弗洛伊德等思想家。在哲学层面，他的作品探讨了自由意志、道德责任和信仰等根本问题。流行文化中，陀思妥耶夫斯基的形象常常与存在主义、虚无主义等思潮联系在一起，他的名言和人物形象被广泛引用和改编。他的生平故事，包括西伯利亚流放和与癫痫病的斗争，也成为传奇的一部分，进一步巩固了他在文化史上的地位。
objective.en: In academic circles and popular culture, Dostoevsky is widely recognized as a giant of 19th-century Russian literature, ranked alongside Tolstoy. His works transcend temporal boundaries, becoming classics that explore the essence of human existence. In psychology, his novels are seen as early examples of psychological analysis, influencing thinkers like Freud. Philosophically, his works address fundamental questions of free will, moral responsibility, and faith. In popular culture, Dostoevsky is often associated with existentialist and nihilistic thought, and his quotes and characters are widely quoted and adapted. His life story, including Siberian exile and his struggle with epilepsy, has also become part of the legend, further cementing his place in cultural history.

others.zh: 陀思妥耶夫斯基是唯一一个让我感到自卑的作家，因为他的才华如此巨大，以至于我有时会想，如果上帝不存在，那么陀思妥耶夫斯基就是上帝。
others.en: Dostoevsky is the only writer who ever made me feel inferior, because his talent was so immense that I sometimes thought that if God didn't exist, Dostoevsky would be God.
